pattern.description: Over continuous 3D product footage (ring spinning on a yoga mat), the centred caption builds word by word: a sans 'Your' is joined by an italic serif 'activity', cut in on the cut to the new shot.
pattern.why_premium: Mixed sans + italic serif pairing gives the key word emphasis without size or colour change; the word arrives on the shot change so caption and picture land as one beat, while the footage carries all the motion.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.w-your', {opacity: 1}).fromTo('.w-activity', {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power1.out'}) placed at the shot cut; footage layer plays underneath, no transform on the caption.
build_hint.remotion: Caption words as spans; activity opacity = interpolate(frame, [cut, cut+3], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); <OffthreadVideo> for the 3D clip in a <Sequence> starting at the same frame.

notes: The italic word appears within ~3 frames (f330 to f333) so it may be a hard cut-on rather than a fade. The ring spin and mat motion are baked footage; b03/b04 are floor slivers. camera.move is none despite the footage appearing to drift.
